paper.title_en: Longitudinal spin transfer to hyperon in SIDIS
paper.abstract_en: In existing fixed-target semi-inclusive deep inelastic scattering (SIDIS) experiments at the medium energies, hyperons originating from current and target fragmentation (TF) regions are not clearly distinct. We investigate the production of $\Lambda$ or $\Sigma^0$ hyperon in the SIDIS process with a polarized lepton beam and find that the spin transfer is significantly suppressed by TF contributions. As further demonstrated by a model estimation, the suppression effect from TF not only alleviates the long-standing tension between experimental data of $\Lambda$ and theoretical predictions solely based on current fragmentation, but also provides a new perspective on the hadronization mechanism.
